text.title: Broken Temple
text.declared_genre: Indietronica / Deep Dub Bass / Ambient Chamber Electronica
text.declared_tempo: 87 BPM, final coda breathes in free time
text.declared_key: D minor moving through F major and ending suspended on A
text.declared_mood: Adult reckoning, addiction-held -> pressure release -> unresolved dignity
text.production_notes: Deep dub sub bass as foundation stone, sparse kick pulses, filtered guitar and piano, low organ, bowed string pads, distant room percussion, controlled saturation in the rupture, long delay tails that collapse inward, final coda strips back to bass, guitar, and human voices
text.vocal_notes: Close, intimate androgynous lead, weary but steady; stacked harmonies in final hook; low octave support in the rupture; outro nearly spoken with group hum, breath kept audible
section_names: Intro - stone hit | breath | low sub
Hook - fuller low end | unresolved warmth
Rupture - full band | saturated bass | sudden drop
Final Hook - stacked harmonies | wide but suspended
Coda - free time | guitar, bass, voices
